findings.description: Zap sizes the swap from live spot getReserves() and calls addLiquidity with amountAMin/amountBMin = 0/0; all price protection rests on pooler-supplied minPhusdOut/minLP, which the UI derives from quotePool() (itself spot). A sandwich (buy phUSD before, sell after) extracts up to the UI tolerance on both the swap leg and the LP leg; no on-chain price reference and no ceiling (deliberate per NatSpec: arb via PhusdStableMinter).
mitigationsPresent: s re-derived from same reserves the swap executes on, so leftover ratio is invariant to a front-run on a synced pair
missingMitigations: No price ceiling vs $1 mint (by design)
findings.notes: New contract, so analogs do not reconcile by fingerprint. Expected Low consistent with L-06 precedent; floors bound loss.

findings.description: Both router calls in UniPoolerV2.pool (L406 swap, L415 addLiquidity) and the new PromotionUniV2_Eth._swapSusdsForPhusd (Leg A swap) pass deadline = block.timestamp, which never expires. A held/delayed pooler tx executes against absolute floors that may be stale relative to the then-market; any favourable move between signing and inclusion is capturable by MEV.

findings.description: Leg A now buys phUSD on the phUSD/sUSDS Uniswap V2 pair (constant-product, likely thin, the same pair UniPoolerV2 provisions) instead of the Balancer 50/50 weighted pool. Protection is only the pooler-supplied minPhusdOut (now required > 0). The L-15 wont-fix rationale was assessed against the Balancer venue; the venue change (different curve, shared with UniPoolerV2 so both pooler txs can be co-sandwiched in one block) warrants re-confirmation rather than silent inheritance.

manualReview.description: s is sized from getReserves(), but a pair with an unsynced surplus (tokens sent without sync()) absorbs that surplus into reserves during swap(); addLiquidity then sees a different ratio than the closed form assumed, leaving a non-dust residual on the pooler (sUSDS re-poolable; phUSD recoverable only via rescueERC20). Contradicts NatSpec claim that a front-run 'never [changes] the leftover'. Attacker funds the surplus (accrues to LPs, mostly the protocol); no extraction path found. Griefing / doc accuracy. quotePool shares the assumption so minLP/minPhusdOut may spuriously revert.
missingMitigations: No sync() or balanceOf(pair)-reserve accounting before sizing

manualReview.description: Constructor validates pair_'s token set but not pair_ == IUniswapV2Factory(router.factory()).getPair(sUSDS, phUSD). Sizing/quote read _pair while the swap and addLiquidity execute on the router factory's canonical pair; a wrong-factory or fork-DEX pair with the same tokens decouples sizing from execution (mis-sized s, wrong quote, LP minted is a different token than pair() reports). Non-obvious deploy-time footgun (Law 3); floors bound loss; LP rescuable. Deploy-script assertion is the cheap mitigation.

Math.sqrt floors and the /1994 floors, so s is rounded down: slightly less phUSD bought, slightly more sUSDS left, router picks amountAOptimal < sUSDSRemaining, leaving wei-level sUSDS on the contract. Direction is protocol-safe (sUSDS residue is re-poolable since pool() reads balanceOf). Any phUSD residue (from router quote rounding) has no consumer except rescueERC20. Not a loop-profitable drain; recorded for completeness (approval residue checked: all router allowances paired to 0; revert on minLP rolls back).

Pair may be empty at construction (cutover deploys pooler before seeding). pool()/quotePool revert UniPoolerV2__EmptyPair, so the pooler itself cannot be the first depositor (V2 MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY also applies). Residual risk lives in the cutover script: a permissionless third party can seed the pair at an arbitrary ratio before the protocol seed; an over-$1 phUSD seed is arbed via PhusdStableMinter, an under-$1 seed favours the pooler. Route to the phStaging2 cutover script audit (seed with ratio check).
missingMitigations: None on-contract; script-side seeding guard not verifiable here

manualReview.description: The mint path is copied verbatim from BalancerPoolerV2, so UniPoolerV2 inherits that contract's open ledger issues under a new fingerprint (they will not reconcile automatically): L-05 e527a71211 (batchDonationSize not coupled to hook ratio; debt accrues on gross amount), L-17 79a2cd4a79 (disabling donation drops parked USDS from the retry loop; psm.gem() read live), L-18 482cefc33e (gemAmt==0 dust branch silent), Q-18 11d8b8656f (unpaired streamer forceApprove), Q-08 96c60b723f (no hookTypeId guard - M-04 class), Q-02 261859a435 (deposit return ignored). Sanitizer/dedup should decide whether to clone-file or attach as branchesSeen-style notes.

quotePool is a spot-priced view (getReserves/totalSupply). Floors derived from it in the same transaction provide no protection; today no on-chain caller exists (MultiPooler targets IUniboostPooler only, 4-arg pool). Flag so any future on-chain integrator (e.g., a MultiPooler extension) does not compute floors on-chain from it.
missingMitigations: NatSpec does not warn against on-chain use
